plan: Screenshots are real output of the app: covers come from the app's own PNG export (captured through headless Chrome/CDP), and the editor shot is the running app with the demo portrait loaded.

shots.shows: The exported wide cover (1920x1080 export scaled to 1280x720): Sunset Grid layout, five treated panels, Sunset grade, bold VICE CITY NIGHTS caption with accent sub-band.
The app running in a browser at 1280x800: control column (photos, layout, grade, caption, export) and the live cover preview with the demo portrait loaded.
shots.source: headless Chrome screenshot of the served app

shots.shows: The exported portrait cover (1080x1350 export scaled to 1024x1280) in the Neon Strip layout with the Neon Nights grade.
The exported square cover (1080x1080) in the Vice Duo layout with the Vice Pink grade.
